description: This Java source file defines the ServiceEngineTestServices class containing multiple static service methods used for testing various service behaviors, such as deadlock retries, lock wait timeouts, transaction handling, and ECA rule executions within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServiceEngineTestServices
classes.description: A class containing static service methods for testing various service-related functionalities such as deadlocks, lock timeouts, transaction management, and ECA event processing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testServiceDeadLockRetry
methods.description: Tests deadlock retry logic by running two asynchronous services and processing their results to determine if errors occurred.

methods.name: testServiceDeadLockRetryThreadA
methods.description: Simulates a transaction that updates 'TestingType' entities with IDs SVCLRT_A, SVCLRT_B, and SVCLRT_AONLY to test deadlock handling.

methods.name: testServiceDeadLockRetryThreadB
methods.description: Simulates a complementary transaction to ThreadA, updating entities SVCLRT_B, SVCLRT_A, and SVCLRT_BONLY to induce deadlock conditions.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetry
methods.description: Tests lock wait timeout retry logic by running two services asynchronously and assessing their results.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetryGrabber
methods.description: Simulates a long-held lock on 'TestingType' entity with ID SVCLWTRT to test lock timeout behavior.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetryWaiter
methods.description: Attempts to update the same entity while the grabber holds a lock, expecting a lock wait timeout.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetryCantRecover
methods.description: Simulates a scenario where a lock cannot be recovered due to transaction and lock conditions, invoking a sub-service in a separate transaction.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetryCantRecoverWaiter
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock on 'TestingType' with ID SVCLWTRTCR', expecting a lock wait timeout.

methods.name: testServiceOwnTxSubServiceAfterSetRollbackOnlyInParentErrorCatchWrapper
methods.description: Runs a sub-service with its own transaction after the parent service has marked the transaction for rollback, catching and logging expected errors.

methods.name: testServiceOwnTxSubServiceAfterSetRollbackOnlyInParent
methods.description: Performs a test of transaction rollback behavior by setting rollback only and invoking a sub-service.

methods.name: testServiceOwnTxSubServiceAfterSetRollbackOnlyInParentSubService
methods.description: A placeholder service to be invoked in transaction testing, performs no operations.

methods.name: testServiceEcaGlobalEventExec
methods.description: Executes a sub-service designed to test global event rule execution and transaction commit behavior.

methods.name: testServiceEcaGlobalEventExecOnCommit
methods.description: Updates a 'TestingType' entity to test behavior after a global commit event.

methods.name: testServiceEcaGlobalEventExecToRollback
methods.description: Simulates a service that triggers a rollback via ECA rules.

methods.name: testServiceEcaGlobalEventExecOnRollback
methods.description: Updates a 'TestingType' entity to test behavior after a global rollback event.
